{{Top|leg}}
'''''Reyve''''' was a [[Class-A cargo container]] that was part of a [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel]] [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighter]] base. The container along with the whole base was destroyed by an [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] attack by the [[EF76 Nebulon-B escort frigate/Legends|frigate]] [[Lightning (EF76 Nebulon-B escort frigate)|''Lightning'']].
